DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この氏名の欄は、ご本人のお名前でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is the name in this field your own?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社の名前を書きました。会社へ出す証明書だからです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社提出を理由に氏名へ会社名を書いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote the company name because the certificate is for submission to my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you wrote the company name in the name field because you will submit it there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 証明の対象者と提出先の記入欄を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us distinguish the fields for the person being certified and the destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね。証明してほしいのは私なので、対象者の名前を訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 証明対象は本人で訂正したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: You are right. The certificate concerns me, so I would like to correct the subject’s name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you are the subject of the certificate and want to correct the entry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 訂正方法を担当が説明します。会社から指定された書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will explain corrections. Do you have any document specified by the company?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この案内です。会社名を証明する書類ではなく、私についての証明を求められています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社案内を示し本人証明の指定だと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: These instructions. They want a certificate concerning me, not a document certifying the company name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the company instructions and explain that they specify a certificate about you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 申請する方もご本人ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You are also the applicant, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、私が申請します。会社の代理で来たと誤解されないように伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人申請で会社代理ではないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I am applying myself. I will make clear that I am not here on the company’s behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear that you are applying personally, not as the company’s representative. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 提出先の欄が必要かも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will also check whether a submission-destination field is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。会社名をすべての名前欄へ書かず、各欄の対象を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名前欄ごとの対象と提出先記載を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Please explain whom each field refers to, rather than having me write the company name in every name field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check whom each name field refers to and how to enter the submission destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。対象者、申請者、提出先を区別して用紙をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will explain the form while distinguishing the subject, applicant and destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 職業の欄について、普段の仕事内容も伺ってよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I also ask about your usual duties for the occupation field?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社名を書きましたが、それだけでは何をしているか伝わりませんね。倉庫で箱を運んでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社名の記入だけでは仕事内容が伝わらず箱を運ぶと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote the company name, but that alone does not explain my work. I carry boxes in a warehouse.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the company name alone does not describe your duties and that you carry boxes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱を運ぶほかに、同じ姿勢を続ける作業はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Besides carrying boxes, do you have tasks where you maintain the same posture?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 低い棚へ入れるために、かがんで腕を伸ばす作業があります。会社員という言葉だけで済ませず、その動きも伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: かがんで腕を伸ばす反復作業を具体的に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I bend down and reach out to put things on low shelves. Rather than just say company employee, I want to explain those movements too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the repeated bending and reaching movements specifically. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 痛みに気付いたのは、どのような時でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: What were you doing when you noticed the pain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の作業中に肩が痛くなりました。ただ、その作業が原因かは自分では決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 作業中の発症時点を述べ原因の断定とは分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: My shoulder started hurting during work yesterday. But I cannot decide myself whether that work caused it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say when pain began during work without treating that as proof of the cause. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 痛みは仕事中だけですか。それとも仕事を終えてからもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Does it hurt only while working, or after work too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰宅後もあります。仕事の時だけと書かず、家で上着を着る時にも痛むことを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰宅後の着衣時にも痛むと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It hurts after I get home too. I will not write that it is only at work; it also hurts when putting on a jacket at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that it also hurts when dressing after returning home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 仕事の曜日や時間帯も、診療担当へ伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also tell the clinician your workdays and hours.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今週は夜勤です。勤務先の名前、実際の動き、痛みに気付いた時点、帰宅後の状態を分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 夜勤と会社名と作業と症状経過を分けて整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I am on night shifts this week. I will explain separately the company name, actual movements, when I noticed pain and how I feel at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize the night shifts, company name, duties and symptom history separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容を記録しました。診療担当へお伝えしますので、仕事内容と痛みの経過をこの記入内容で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have recorded that. I will pass it to the clinician, so please check that these entries describe your duties and pain history correctly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何を相手へ伝えてしまいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What did you tell the other person?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 本人確認と言われて、携帯に届いた数字のコードを読み上げました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人確認と言われ認証コードを伝えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: They said it was for identity verification, so I read out the numerical code that arrived on my phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you gave an authentication code after being told it was for identity verification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのコードの通知には、どのサービスの名前がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which service was named in the notification containing that code?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分が使っているサービスです。でも、その時はログイン操作をしていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: サービス名と本人ログイン未操作の状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: A service I use. But I was not trying to log in at that time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the service name and explain that you were not logging in yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 意図しない操作の可能性もあるので、サービスの公式な窓口へ状況を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: It may involve an action you did not intend, so report the situation to the service’s official support.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、電話の相手に続きを聞かず、自分で確認した窓口へ、コードを伝えたことを知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相手との継続でなく確認した公式窓口へ報告すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will not continue asking the caller. I will report that I shared the code to an official contact I verify myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will report to a verified official contact rather than continue with the caller. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 支払いやアカウントの状態は確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you checked payments or your account status?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。被害がないと決めず、ログイン状況や利用の確認方法も聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 利用状態未確認で確認方法の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I will not assume there was no harm; I will also ask how to check logins and activity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that activity is unconfirmed and ask how to check it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 電話の記録と通知は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you still have the call record and notification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 残しています。相談先にコードをもう一度読み上げるのではなく、時刻と経緯を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録を保持しコード再共有でなく時刻と経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Instead of reading the code out again to whoever I consult, I will explain the time and what happened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the records and explain the time and events instead of sharing the code again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。必要な記録を保ち、サービス側の対応とこちらでの相談を分けて進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Preserve the necessary records and handle the service’s response separately from your consultation here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 荷物の内容を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what is in the parcel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 空の瓶です。ただ、底に少し液体が残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 空瓶に少量液体が残ると申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: An empty bottle. However, a little liquid remains at the bottom.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Declare that a small amount of liquid remains in the empty bottle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 完全に空という状態ではないのですね。残っている液体の種類はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: So it is not completely empty. Do you know what the remaining liquid is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 掃除用の液体です。少量なら内容に含めなくてよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 清掃液で少量は申告不要と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: A cleaning liquid. I thought a small amount did not need to be included in the contents declaration.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is cleaning liquid and you thought a small amount did not need declaring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 種類と状態によって発送条件を確認します。表示が残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the shipping conditions according to the substance and its state. Is the label still there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 瓶のラベルがあります。においだけで種類を決めず、その表示を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: においで判断せずラベルを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The bottle still has its label. I will show it instead of identifying the liquid just by its smell.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the label instead of judging by smell. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ確認します。すでに箱に詰めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check with the person in charge. Is it already packed in a box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 仮に入れていますが、封は閉じていません。空容器として受付を進めず、条件を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仮梱包未封で空容器として進めず条件確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I placed it in one temporarily, but it is not sealed. I would like to check the conditions rather than proceed as if it were an empty container.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that it is temporarily packed but unsealed and ask about conditions instead of declaring an empty container. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 梱包方法と送付可否を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain packaging and whether it can be sent.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。液体を勝手に別の瓶へ移して送るのではなく、現在の状態を伝えて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別容器へ勝手に移さず現状態で相談すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will explain its current condition and ask, rather than transfer the liquid to another bottle myself and send it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask about its present condition without transferring it to another container yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。容器と残液の表示を確認し、発送の可否と必要な準備をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will check the container and remaining-liquid labeling and explain whether it can be sent and what preparation is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座番号は案内の通りに入力されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you entered the account number exactly as instructed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先頭がゼロだったので、メモするときに消しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 口座番号の先頭ゼロを省いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It started with zero, so I left that out when writing it down.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you omitted the leading zero in the account number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座番号の桁を、数量の数字と同じように省かないで確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the account-number digits without dropping them as if it were a quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: わかりました。数なら同じと思いましたが、番号として照合したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 数量と同じ扱いを訂正し番号照合を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I thought the numerical value was the same, but I want to compare it as an identifying number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct treating it as a quantity and ask to compare the account number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 元の案内は手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have the original instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 写真があります。省略したメモだけを使わず、元の桁を見て入力し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元案内写真から全桁を見て再入力すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a photo. I will not use only my abbreviated note; I will enter it again using all the original digits.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will reenter every digit from the photo of the original instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 種類や支店番号も合わせて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the account type and branch number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、各欄を別に照合します。口座番号の先頭を支店番号へ移すような直し方はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 種類と支店番号を別欄で確認し桁を移さないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I will check each field separately. I will not fix it by moving the first account-number digit into the branch number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check type and branch number in their own fields without moving digits. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認画面の受取人名もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the recipient name on the confirmation screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。一致を確認する前に送金せず、不明なら案内元へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名義照合前に送金せず不明なら依頼元へ確認すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not transfer money before confirming a match, and will ask the sender of the instructions if unclear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not transfer before matching the name and will ask the requester if unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。元の資料で番号の全桁と各項目を見直して進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Review every digit and each field using the original material before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、一番小さい物でお願いします。安い袋がよいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 安い小袋を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, the smallest one please. I would prefer a cheap bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a small inexpensive bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この長い商品が入るか、袋の大きさを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the size to see whether this long item fits.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 確かに上が出ますね。安さだけで選んで、持ち運びを考えていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 長商品が出ることに気づき携行を考えていなかったと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The top does stick out. I chose only by price and did not think about carrying it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you noticed the long item sticks out and had not considered carrying it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 大きい袋や持参した袋を使う方法があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can use a larger bag or one you brought yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は持参していません。商品の袋を折って無理に入れるより、合う大きさを選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持参袋なしで無理に折らず合うサイズを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I did not bring one today. Rather than bend the product’s packaging to force it in, I want a suitable size.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you brought no bag and want a fitting size without forcing or folding the item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 大きい袋の料金はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This is the price of the large bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。袋代を含む合計を確認して、その大きさでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 大袋料金込みの合計確認後に選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Please use that size after checking the total including the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose after checking the total including the larger bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 長い商品とほかの商品を一緒に入れてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: May I put the long item and the other products together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 重い物が上に乗らないよう分けて入れたいです。袋がもう一枚必要なら料金を先に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 重物を上に置かず追加袋が必要なら事前料金案内を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would like them separated so heavy items are not placed on top. If another bag is needed, please tell me its price first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask not to put heavy items on top and to state any additional bag charge beforehand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。大きさと袋の枚数を決めて、合計を確認してから会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will decide the size and number of bags, confirm the total, then complete the payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: これから散歩されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you about to go for a walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、照明の印があるので、暗くなるまで歩いても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 照明印で暗くなるまで散歩できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There is a lighting symbol, so is it fine to walk until it gets dark?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the lighting symbol means you can walk until dark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 照明のある場所と、通行できる時間や現在の状態は分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check lit locations separately from access times and present conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね。印だけで夜も全部明るいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 印だけで夜も全面明るいと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: You are right. I thought the symbol meant the entire area would be bright at night too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you assumed the symbol meant full lighting at night. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の利用案内を確認します。帰りの時間は決めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the current visitor information. Have you decided when to return?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 日が暮れる前に出口へ戻りたいです。今から短く歩ける道を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 暗くなる前に戻る短経路を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to be back at the exit before sunset. Please show me a short route I can walk now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a short route that returns before dark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 短い経路を確認します。出口からの移動もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check a short route. Do you need to travel farther after the exit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 徒歩で家まで帰ります。園内だけでなく、外を歩く時間も残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自宅徒歩分も残す必要を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will walk home. I need to leave time for walking outside the park too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you also need to allow time to walk home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 全体の時間に余裕を持って選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please choose with spare time for the whole journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、道を延ばすより、早めに戻る経路にします。分岐の目印も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 延長より早め帰路を選び分岐目印を確認すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Rather than extend the walk, I will choose an early return route. I will check the landmarks at junctions too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will choose an earlier return instead of extending and check junction landmarks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今使える短い道と帰りの出口をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will show you a short route currently open and the exit for your return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの乗り継ぎを予定されていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この列車から次の便です。こちらが遅れたら、次も待ってくれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遅延時に接続列車が待つか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: From this train to the next service. If this one is late, will the next one wait?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a connecting train waits if your train is delayed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 接続の扱いは個別の案内を確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the specific connection information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 必ず待つと思っていました。今の案内で乗り継げるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 必ず待つと思ったことを訂正し現在案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it would always wait. Please tell me whether I can connect according to the current information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct your assumption that it always waits and ask for current information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乗り継ぎ先の列車名と時刻を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the connecting train’s name and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。次の便を逃すと、その後のバスも変わるので、順に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 列車時刻を示し次のバスへの影響も伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here they are. If I miss it, my later bus changes too, so I would like to check each leg in order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the train time and explain the effect on the following bus. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 列車とバスはそれぞれ確認が必要ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The train and bus each need separate checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、列車が待つかだけで、バスも待つとは考えません。バスの連絡先も調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 列車とバスの接続条件を別に確認すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Even if the train waits, I will not assume the bus waits too. I will look up the bus contact as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check train and bus connection conditions separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の案内で別の便も候補にできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Other services can also be considered based on the current information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。元の接続が保証されたとは伝えず、同行者に現在の候補を知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 接続保証とせず代替候補を同行者へ知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will tell my travel companions the current alternatives without saying the original connection is guaranteed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell companions the alternatives without claiming a guaranteed connection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認できた列車の案内をお伝えしますので、続く移動もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will give the train information we have confirmed; please check the following travel arrangements too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約の取り消しをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to cancel an appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、メールを書いています。この番号を入れればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 取消メールの番号が正しいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am writing an email. Should I include this number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the number in your cancellation email is correct. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 取り消したい相談の予約番号か確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check that it is the appointment number for the consultation you want to cancel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この番号は前の相談でした。今回のメールにそのままコピーしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前相談番号をコピーしたと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This was the number of my previous consultation. I had copied it straight into this email.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct the copied reference from the previous consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ送信していませんか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 未送信です。前の相談を取り消さないよう、今回の確認メールを探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未送信で今回確認メールを探すと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I will find this appointment’s confirmation email so I do not cancel the previous consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the message is unsent and you will find the current confirmation email. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 日時と相談内容も照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please compare the date, time and consultation topic too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、今週金曜の住宅相談です。前の仕事の相談とは分けて番号を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今回住宅相談と前仕事相談を分けて照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. This is a housing consultation this Friday. I will check its number separately from my previous work consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the current housing consultation separately from the previous work consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 正しい番号が確認できたら、担当の取消方法に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you confirm the correct number, follow the desk’s cancellation procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。送っただけで完了とは考えず、取消結果も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正番号で案内に従い取消結果まで確認すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not assume sending the email completes it; I will check the cancellation result too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will follow the instructions with the correct number and check the cancellation result. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。番号、日時、内容を合わせて、今回の予約だけを相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Match the number, date, time and topic and inquire only about this appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類のお受け取りについてですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、費用を払ったので、もうかばんに入っていると思って帰りかけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 費用支払で書類も入手済みと思って帰りかけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Since I had paid, I thought the documents were already in my bag and almost left.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that after paying you assumed you had the documents and nearly left. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会計で渡されたものを確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you check what the payment desk gave you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 領収書だけです。書類を受け取ったかは確認していませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 渡されたのは領収書だけで受取未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only a receipt. I had not checked whether I received the documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you were given only a receipt and had not confirmed document collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発行状況を担当に確認します。申込時の控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the issuing status with the person in charge. Do you have your application slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。支払い済みと受け取り済みを分けて、この控えで確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 申込控えで支払いと受取状態を分けて調べてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Please use it to check payment and collection as separate statuses.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check payment and collection separately using your application slip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 出来上がりの案内は受けていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you been told when the documents would be ready?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日できると聞きましたが、受取窓口を覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 完成予定は今日だが窓口は不明と示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was told today, but I do not remember the collection counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that they were expected to be ready today but you do not know the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 控えの番号で確認できました。書類は二階の書類受取窓口で受け取れます。この控えをご提示ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I checked using the slip number. You can collect them at the document collection counter on the second floor. Please show this slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。領収書を提出用書類の代わりにせず、必要な書類を受け取る場所へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 領収書代用せず本来書類を受取る窓口へ行くと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will not use the receipt instead of the documents I need to submit; I will go to collect the proper documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will collect the actual documents rather than substitute the payment receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、控えを持って二階の書類受取窓口へお進みください。領収書は支払いの記録として別に保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13228-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your slip to the second-floor document collection counter. Keep the payment receipt separately as your payment record.
